summary: You can build lasting love, but it asks you to reach for it. The makings of real commitment are there: loyalty, patience, the willingness to show up. They turn on when you use them.
body: You can build lasting love, but it asks you to reach for it. The makings of real commitment are there: loyalty, patience, the willingness to show up. They turn on when you use them. Left idle, you might keep love at arm's length or wait for proof before investing. But when you choose to commit, to put in the steady work a bond needs, it holds. The opening rewards effort. Reach for it and you get the durable kind of love most people only talk about.
gift: At your best: patient, loyal, able to build love that holds.
shadow: The trap: keeping love at arm's length and waiting for a certainty that never quite comes.
integration: Let love and values and discipline and limits cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Loyal and hardworking; the risk is joyless striving and a belief that reward must be suffered for.
do: Put in the steady work a bond needs
Reach for commitment instead of waiting on it
dont: Wait for certainty before you invest
